external.description: While the long-awaited foldable iPhone has often been referred to as the iPhone Ultra or the iPhone Fold in rumors, another name making the rounds is iPhone Duo.
external.title: iPhone Duo? — MacRumors

record.originalText: #iPhoneDuo is a better name given that the rumoured phone has two displays (duh!), whereas #Apple normally reserves ‘ultra’ for higher tier ‘pro’ devices, which this is not. The price, however, will be ‘ultra’. #iPhone apple.news/AoY629KMZSUO...
